title: Granite Quarry
subtitle: West of Yanshi, Underminer Leader and the Lower Undermine portal
steps: Run west of Yanshi to the Granite Quarry (11.8S 39.0E). It's an open entrance with no portal.
Keep left to the Underminer Leader and loot the Underminer Notes.
Give the notes to Royal Guard Adrana in Yanshi.
Back in the quarry, keep right to the Yanshi Lower Undermine portal.

notes.title: Underminer Leader
notes.body: Level 160, guarded by five level 135 Underminers. He carries the Underminer Notes.

notes.title: Nothing locked
notes.body: There are no locked doors or levers on either route.

notes.title: Portal onward
notes.body: The Yanshi Lower Undermine portal leads to the Repugnant Eaters. Take the Eater task from Xun Yu in Eastwatch before you come.
